text:
marie: Kicking off Aurelia Health perf check. Need heterogeneous workload runnotes + tail-latency breakdown for multi-model routing case. Can infra run a quick pass today? @ashwin @nia
ashwin: can do. Do you want mixed prompts (short q + long doc summarize) or steady long tokens only?
marie: Mixed. 70% short (10-40 tok), 30% long (500-1k tok). Burst spikes up to 400qps for 10s. Target p95 < 220ms, p99 < 500ms for short requests.
ashwin: SG. Plan: 1) baseline single-model (redwood-open-7b-quant) 2) routing test (open-7b -> open-13b fallback) 3) dedicated pool vs hosted. I'll run locust with 20 workers. Sample config:

``
locustfile.py: 
--users=200 --spawn-rate=50 --run-time=10m
payload = mix(short=0.7, long=0.3)
```

ashwin: Also will enable prefix-KV cache and batch_size=64 for short requests. Expect throughput difference ~x2 for cached flow.

nia: FYI pricing ask from AE: show token burn delta between cached vs uncached, and incremental cost for dedicated pool (monthly). I can compile numbers after run. @samir are there any sec flags if we demo dedicated?

samir: For demo Dedicated/PV we need to flag KMS integration on their questionnaire, but no blockers. Make sure logs redact PHI. Also note on private: can't share raw logs outside customer VPC.

ci-bot: test-run-2813334444 started by ashwin — harness: locust, 200 users, mix payload

ashwin: quick interim:
- baseline single hosted: sustained 120 qps, p95 260ms (short), p99 580ms
- with KV cache enabled: sustained 240 qps, p95 190ms, p99 420ms
- routing to 13b fallback under spike: tail spikes to ~1.2s for long requests, short stays under 500ms

ashwin: attaching runnotes and raw trace link: https://internal.pulse/runs/2813334444 (don't share externally)

marie: Can you capture token counts per request? AE wants per-call cost estimates.

ashwin: yes. sample per-request tokens: short 35 tok gen, long 720 tok gen. with cache short reduces to 5 gen tok. I'll add CSV.

nia: Cost quick math: hosted unit price $0.0004 per gen token; cached short ~ $0.000002 per call vs uncached $0.014. Dedicated amortized reduces token compute by 30% for same throughput; I'll produce a one-pager.

marie: Great. Also highlight fallback policy: can we auto-fail to smaller model if 13b tail > 800ms?

ashwin: yes — we tested auto-fallback at 800ms: switch time ~150ms, user-visible tail reduced. Will put config snippet.

``
routing:
  - if latency>800ms -> route: open-7b-quant
  - cooldown: 30s
```

samir: Note: fallback must be recorded in audit logs per compliance. Add flag in runnotes.

nia: I'll draft the customer-facing summary after we get final CSVs. Expect around EOD.

marie: Thanks team :thumbsup:
